name: Ima Nandemo Suru tte Itta yo ne?
original_name: 今何でもするって言ったよね？
source:
Onyx, the butler, was celebrating the birthday of his master, Jeffrey. It's a special day for his master, who has always treated him well. A simple gift just wouldn't cut it this time, so he said:

"To make today wonderful, I will do anything."

"Anything, you say?"

His master heard him loud and clear. Thus, Onyx was in for a day of embarrassment.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/28268]Freem![/url]]
